full_text:
Unnamed Titan 001 is a draconic Titan which possesses eight spikes on its head. Its scales are a yellow-green color.

History

During an ancient ritual performed by a three ancient Seekers, this Titan was sealed within a gold Amulet with a red gem. This Amulet was then sealed within a box and hidden. [A Seeker Is Born]

Gallery

Image caption: Amulet

Trivia

• In the original concept trailer for Season 1, this Titan's Amulet was found by Lok (then named Jason); the footage was later reused for the S1 opening theme.
• This Titan is similar in appearance to Shakrit, a Blood Spiral Swara-Titan and Grand Dragon Leviathan, the Legendary Titan of the Deeps who appears in the Huntik Magazine comics.
